questions.question: How often do nodes broadcast Link-State Packets?

answers.b: At regular intervals or when the network changes

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the forwarding table in Link-State Routing?

answers.a: It stores only directly connected neighbors
answers.b: It maps each destination to the next-hop node on the shortest path
answers.c: It contains the entire network topology
answers.d: It lists all possible paths to a destination

questions.question: What is the primary advantage of Link-State Routing over Distance Vector Routing?

answers.b: Faster convergence and no count-to-infinity problem
answers.d: Better suited for small networks only

questions.question: How does a node update D(v) for a neighbor v in the Link-State algorithm?
What is the final output of the Link-State algorithm?

answers.a: A complete routing table containing next-hop nodes
answers.b: A set of shortest paths but no forwarding information
answers.c: A list of all network devices
answers.d: A distance vector for each node
